proposals.title: Explain one useful conversation refusal
proposals.design: Use an existing actor/action and its real eligibility to select a short reason and an earned alternate reply. Keep every reasonable route reachable after its condition changes. Medium scope; no general dialogue engine.
proposals.gate: Preview twice without mutation, commit an eligible exchange once, recheck a lost prerequisite, and retain the exact outcome after save/reload/import.
proposals.compatibility: Future owner must reread current state and choose saved-field defaults/migration before implementation. Existing run state must not be retroactively enrolled.

proposals.title: Preserve a short recap beside full quest text
proposals.design: Attach an authored synopsis to an existing committed milestone, separately from its full passage. Show it in a desktop history panel; reading itself gives no new reward. Low to medium scope.
proposals.gate: Earn the milestone, close/reopen text and reload; one correct recap remains and no duplicate material reward occurs.
proposals.compatibility: Future owner must reread current state and choose saved-field defaults/migration before implementation. Existing run state must not be retroactively enrolled.

proposals.title: Keep timer subject and area together
proposals.design: Give one existing delayed actor/material job an explicit saved subject and area scope, only if current schema lacks it. Missing or moved subjects pause/refuse instead of silently settling elsewhere. Medium scope.
proposals.gate: Save pending work, leave its area, reload and import; settle exactly once at the declared owner or show a stable reason for pause.
proposals.compatibility: Future owner must reread current state and choose saved-field defaults/migration before implementation. Existing run state must not be retroactively enrolled.

proposals.title: Protect the old artifact on rejected restore
proposals.design: Audit existing candidate publication before changing it. Extend only a concrete uncovered failure: malformed candidate, unknown schema or unresolved actor links. Do not copy NetHack's destructive restore edge.
proposals.gate: A rejected candidate changes neither current state nor last-good save; valid generated save/reload/literal Import retain all relevant identities.
proposals.compatibility: Future owner must reread current state and choose saved-field defaults/migration before implementation. Existing run state must not be retroactively enrolled.

proposals.title: Retain participation beside a voluntary conduct result
proposals.design: Reuse current feat receipts for one eligible repeatable activity with not-entered, active, met, broken and withdrawn distinctions. Do not re-add the now-present vial label view or impose a fixed solo-player attempt limit. Medium scope.
proposals.gate: Unentered preview earns nothing; a committed violation affects only that attempt; a later eligible attempt can close successfully and persists exactly.
proposals.compatibility: Future owner must reread current state and choose saved-field defaults/migration before implementation. Existing run state must not be retroactively enrolled.
